_comment: Enforcement manifest for CRIT-3-B (raw-socket coverage gap). network_security_config.xml only governs Android's HTTP stack (HttpURLConnection/HttpsURLConnection, WebView, OkHttp-via-NetworkSecurityPolicy) -- it has zero effect on java.net.Socket/DatagramSocket/ServerSocket instantiated directly, which is how every non-HTTP remote-access protocol in this app talks to the network. That is a platform limitation, not something an XML edit can close. This manifest is the actual enforcement mechanism: every file that opens a raw socket must be listed here with a reviewed justification tag, and verify_socket_security.py (run as a Gradle task wired into `check`) fails the build if a new, unlisted raw-socket call site is introduced. This converts an undetectable silent gap into a build-breaking, reviewable event.

tags.PROTOCOL_INHERENT_CLEARTEXT: Protocol is cleartext by design/RFC; encryption is only ever available as an explicit user opt-in wrapper (SSH tunnel, useTls flag), never implied by this file.
tags.TOFU_TLS_WRAPPED: Raw socket is immediately wrapped in an SSLSocket validated by a TOFU X509TrustManager (pins + hard-rejects on change) -- see com.systemsgo.hex.security.TofuTrustManager.
tags.LOCAL_LOOPBACK_ONLY: Socket never leaves the device (127.0.0.1 bind for an in-process proxy/tunnel bridge); no network-path MITM surface.
tags.OWN_CRYPTO_LAYER: Protocol carries its own encryption/auth beneath the socket (e.g. Mosh's AES-OCB, SNMPv3 USM, IPMI RMCP+), independent of TLS/NetworkSecurityPolicy.
tags.SERVER_SELF_SIGNED_TLS: This app acts as the TLS server (generates its own keypair) rather than a client validating a remote cert.

entries.note: AMT IDE-Redirection; wrapped in SSLSocket + TofuTrustManager.
AMT KVM redirection; wrapped in SSLSocket + TofuTrustManager.
AMT Serial-Over-LAN redirection; wrapped in SSLSocket + TofuTrustManager.

TransportBackedSocket is a fake Socket subclass that never calls connect() itself -- it only exists to let SSLSocketFactory.createSocket() layer a TLS handshake on top of an already-open AmtRedirectionTransport (CIRA). Wrapped via TofuTrustManager exactly like AmtSolSession/AmtKvmSession/AmtIderSession.
LAN host/port discovery probes (connect-scan); no credentials exchanged.
IPMI v2.0 RMCP+/Cipher-Suite session; auth+confidentiality (when cipher suite > 0) live inside the RMCP+ payload, not TLS.
Modbus TCP has no transport-layer encryption in this client; cleartext by protocol design.
Mosh datagrams are AES-128-OCB encrypted end-to-end at the application layer regardless of transport.
Accepts the inbound Call-Home TCP connection; NetconfClient immediately wraps it in SSLSocket + NetconfTlsTofuTrustManager (SSH Call-Home variant is auth'd by JSch instead).
NFSv3/ONC-RPC has no native transport encryption; relies on network-layer trust (LAN/VPN) or an SSH tunnel the user sets up explicitly.

ServerSocket(0, 1, 127.0.0.1) loopback bridge for the noVNC client -- same shape as RdpWebSocketTransport. Outbound leg is the OkHttp wss:// WebSocket, which network_security_config.xml already covers.
RDP serial-port-over-TCP redirection channel; encryption is whatever the RDP session itself negotiates upstream.
Loopback bridge for the native FreeRDP bridge; outbound leg is the OkHttp WebSocket (TLS, TOFU/pinned).
rlogin has no encrypted mode; cleartext by protocol design, legacy/opt-in use only.
RTSP is cleartext by default; optional useTls wraps in standard SSLSocketFactory.getDefault() (system CA trust, not TOFU).
Raw TCP serial-console passthrough (e.g. ser2net); cleartext by design.
SNMP v1/v2c is cleartext by spec; v3 USM auth/priv lives inside the PDU, not a transport-layer TLS session.
Inbound SNMP trap/inform listener; same v1/v2c/v3 model as SnmpClient.
Local SOCKS front-end for SSH dynamic port forwarding; traffic egresses through the encrypted SSH channel.
Local ServerSocket for the SSH local-forward bridge; the actual remote leg goes over the already-encrypted SSH channel via JSch.
Plain Telnet by default; optional TLS-Telnet wrap uses TOFU-style verifyServerCertificate.
"Test Connection" button: plain TCP connect-scan reachability probe (performTcpConnectionTest); no credentials or protocol data ever exchanged.
WoL magic packet (UDP broadcast) + optional TCP reachability probe; no credentials/confidentiality ever in scope.
Apple Remote Desktop admin/UDP discovery+control channel.

ServerSocket(0, 1, 127.0.0.1) loopback bridge for the noVNC client -- same shape as RdpWebSocketTransport/ProxmoxVncBridge. Outbound leg is the OkHttp wss:// WebSocket, which network_security_config.xml already covers.
VNC/RFB; VeNCrypt TLS sub-type only when negotiated.
